lines.text: Ava wants one fourth of the pizza. Tap slices to put them on the plate.
Count the slices left, then count all the slices.
Ivy wants six eighths of the pizza. Tap slices to put them on the plate.
Leo takes a slice without looking. What is the chance it is pepperoni? Write the fraction in simplest form.
Max wants two fourths of the pizza. Tap slices to put them on the plate.
Rosa says: cut my pizza into halves. That means two equal pieces.
Rosa wants one half plus one fourth. Tap slices to put them on the plate.
Three fourths plus one sixth. Both pizzas are re-sliced into twelfths. Add the slices.
Type a number in each box first.
What is two fourths of one half of a pizza? A slice of a slice.
Write four fifths as a decimal.
